info.title: What is category B license?
info.description: Category B is the standard car driving license in Denmark, allowing you to drive regular passenger cars. It is the most popular license category and your path to freedom on the road.

features.title: Drive cars up to 3,500 kg
features.text: With a category B license, you may drive regular passenger cars with up to 8 seats in addition to the driver.

features.title: Trailer allowed
features.text: You may tow a light trailer as long as the total weight does not exceed 3,500 kg.

features.title: Minimum age: 16 years and 9 months
features.text: You must be 17 years old to obtain a category B license, but you can start the training at 16 years and 9 months.

info.closing: At Lønbæks Driving School, we guide you safely through the entire process - from theory classes to the day you receive your license. Start your journey today!

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to the most common questions.

items.question: How long does it take to get a driver's license?
items.answer: It depends on how quickly you complete the theory and driving lessons, but most people get their driver's license within 3–6 months.

items.question: Do you offer both manual and automatic transmission?
items.answer: Yes, we provide lessons in both manual and automatic transmission cars.

items.question: Can I get a driver's license if I am under 18?
items.answer: Yes, you can start theory and driving lessons from the age of 16 years and 9 months, but the practical test can only be taken at 17. When driving at 17, there are rules about having a supervising adult in the car.

items.question: How do the tests work?
items.answer: You must pass both a theoretical test and a practical driving test. We help you prepare for both.

items.question: Can I pay in installments?
items.answer: Yes, we offer flexible payment plans so you can pay for the driver's license in several installments without extra fees.

items.question: What happens if I don’t pass the first time?
items.answer: No panic! You can sign up for a retest. We offer additional lessons to make sure you are ready next time. However, there will be a new fee to the Danish Road Traffic Authority, and if it is the driving test, there will also be a new payment for the car and the instructor’s time.

hero.title: How to Pass the Theory Test
hero.paragraph1: Are you taking the theory test for a Category B driver’s license in Vejle? During lessons at the driving school, you will receive a complete guide to the test structure, the allowed number of mistakes, and the best strategies to pass on your first attempt.
hero.paragraph2: The theory test is an important part of getting your driver’s license. With proper preparation, realistic practice tests, and a solid understanding of traffic laws, you significantly increase your chances of success.

stats.title: 25 Questions
stats.text: Questions about traffic signs, positioning and risk assessment.

stats.title: Max 5 Mistakes
stats.text: You must answer at least 20 correctly.

how.title: How does the theory test work?
how.p1: When attending the theory test, you must bring your application, lesson plan, and valid photo ID (a passport is recommended). The test is digital and lasts 25 minutes.
how.p2: You may have a maximum of 5 mistakes to pass. The result is shown immediately on the screen, so you can see right away whether you passed.
how.p3: We recommend practicing online and reviewing your lesson plan thoroughly. Students who follow the lessons usually develop a high level of understanding, which leads to a higher pass rate.

location.title: Where does the test take place?
location.p1: The theory test takes place at the Danish Road Traffic Authority. Arrive on time and bring valid identification.
location.p2: Once you have passed the theory test, you can continue toward the practical driving test.

koereproeve.intro: Are you preparing for your driving test in Vejle? With our driving school and thorough preparation, you can significantly increase your chances of passing on the first attempt. Our professional instructors help you build safe driving habits and give you the experience needed to feel confident behind the wheel.
koereproeve.note: The driving test is the final part of your license process and requires both technical understanding and practical skills. Our driving school ensures you are fully prepared through structured lessons, realistic driving situations, and personalized feedback, so you can approach the test with confidence.

cards.durationText: The practical test typically lasts up to 25 minutes.
cards.technicalText: You start with questions about the car’s equipment.
cards.trafficText: You drive in different traffic situations.

how.heading: How does the driving test in Vejle work?
how.step1: The driving test in Vejle usually starts with a technical check of the car. You will be asked to explain or demonstrate how different parts of the vehicle function, such as lights, brakes, and steering. With training from a professional driving school, you will be well prepared for this part.
how.step2: After that, the actual driving begins, where the examiner evaluates your awareness, your ability to adjust speed, and how you handle traffic situations. An experienced instructor from a driving school in Vejle will train you in city driving, roundabouts, intersections, and parking, so you can feel confident throughout the test.

where.heading: Where does the driving test take place?
where.step1: The driving test in Vejle usually starts at the Danish Road Traffic Authority’s test center. When you choose a local driving school in Vejle, you will be trained in the same areas and traffic conditions that you will encounter during the test, increasing your chances of passing.
